senses.gloss: m. (= סאור, v. סִיאוּר) fermentation, froth, leaven; trnsf. (cmp. שְׂאוֹר, עִיסָה a. חָמַץ) germ, original nature, character.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 92b">Snh. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>סו̇רו̇</he> his haughty nature; [oth. opin.: its (the kiln’s) froth], v. <cite ref="M02443"><he>מָקַק</he></cite> a. <cite ref="M02760"><he>מָרַק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 82a:6-10">Kidd. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שעסקיו סורו רע …</he> he who has a business which brings him in contact with women, has bad leaven in him (or else he would not have chosen such a trade).
<cite ref="Horayot 13a:24">Hor. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שסוֹרָן רע</he> because they (the mice) are of a mischievous nature.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 59b">B. Mets. 59ᵇ</cite> the Torah cautions repeatedly against ill-treating the proselyte (<cite ref="C01225"><he>גֵּר</he></cite>), <he>מפני שסורו רע</he> because his original character is bad (into which ill treatment might cause him to relapse).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 17b:17">Kidd. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>שמא יחזור לסורו</he> lest he (the proselyte) relapse &c., v. <cite ref="S00986"><he>קִילְקוּל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 70:5">Gen. R. s. 70</cite> <he>היה חוזר לסורו</he> he (Aquila) might have gone back to his evil ways (to heathenism); v. <cite ref="O00518"><he>סִיאוּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 74:17">Gen. R. s. 74</cite>, end (expl. <he>למקומו</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 32:1">Gen. XXXII, 1</cite>) <he>לסורו</he> to his evil manners (sensual pleasures).
Cant. R. to II, 5; a. e.—Pl. סוֹרִים degenerate, bad people.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 3:6">Num. R. s. 3</cite> <he>אפי׳ סוֹרֵיהֶן וכ׳</he> even the bad among them are charitable; (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> <he>בּוֹרִים שבהם</he>).
